defs.def: an alcoholic drink made from the juice of grapes that has been left to ferment. There are many different kinds of wine. 葡萄酒

ex.s: This nice Cantonese restaurant in Columbia Heights quickly became a destination for chef Henji Cheung’s Hong Kong-style cooking and co-owner Sarah Thompson’s natural wine list that earned her a Michelin nod.
ex.t: 这家位于哥伦比亚高地的不错的粤餐厅，凭借主厨Henji Cheung的港式烹饪和合伙人Sarah Thompson的天然酒单迅速成为热门去处，酒单还为她赢得了米其林的认可。

ex.s: It was ___23___ called Mario, coming to ___24___ us a box containing some tomatoes and a bottle of wine.
ex.t: 那是一位___23___名叫马里奥的人，来给我们___24___一个盒子，里面装着一些西红柿和一瓶葡萄酒。

ex.s: Mario’s wine may have been cloudy and come out of an old bottle, but it was ___37___.
ex.t: 马里奥的葡萄酒也许浑浊，还装在旧瓶子里，但它很___37___。

ex.s: The man drinks too much wine.
ex.t: 那个男人喝的葡萄酒太多。
那个男人很少喝葡萄酒。

ex.s: People celebrate the festival by climbing mountains, appreciating chrysanthemum flowers and drinking chrysanthemum wine.
ex.t: 人们通过登山、赏菊和饮菊花酒来庆祝这个节日。

ex.s: His artistic talent was discovered by accident when he was sent to the poet Wang Wei’s house to collect payment for some wine.
ex.t: 他的艺术才华是在一次偶然中被发现的：当时他被派到诗人王维家中收取酒钱。

ex.s: To have a chance of experiencing this, stop by a village pub and relax with a glass of wine or a local beer.
ex.t: 要想有机会体验这种生活，不妨到乡村小酒馆歇脚，喝一杯葡萄酒或当地啤酒放松一下。

ex.s: Today was my first day back in San Francisco after camping in the Redwood Forest and visiting the wine country of Napa Valley.
ex.t: 今天是我露营红木森林、游览纳帕谷葡萄酒产区后回到旧金山的第一天。

ex.s: Widely known as a genius and often called the “Immortal Poet”, Li Bai (701–762) wrote with a romantic style and his poems celebrated things such as friendship, nature, and wine.
ex.t: 李白（701–762）被誉为天才，常被称为“诗仙”，他以浪漫风格写作，其诗作歌颂友谊、自然和酒等事物。

ex.s: Here you can enjoy 4 pours of some of the best wine San Francisco has to offer.
ex.t: 在这里你可以品尝到4杯旧金山最好的葡萄酒。

defs.def: an alcoholic drink made from plants or fruits other than grapes （用植物或除葡萄以外的水果酿制的）酒，果酒
a dark red colour 紫红色；深红色
